high_level_description: This image shows the exterior of a building with a signboard prominently displayed on its facade. The building appears to be a two-story structure with a light-colored wall and a reddish-brown awning over the entrance on the left side. The awning is supported by metal bars. The signboard is white with black text and includes both Tamil script and English. The Tamil text reads "வெள்ளி பிரிக் இந்தியாயர்ம் எல்லையோடி," which translates to "White Brick Engineers"
